name: a light that knows what to fall on
description: A lamp, doing the one thing it has ever wanted to do, on exactly the right object.
looks: It moves onto the right thing and settles, and it is right.
The light is older than the fitting by a very long way.
It goes round things, and takes its time about it.
says: There. That one. Look at that one.
I have been pointing at it all along.
